Dear Daniel,
After our check, we can see that the charger is online and not  offline as you reported. The only thing that appears on our side is some error flags related to the door being open or not properly closed. If someone is working on the charger, that’s fine, but otherwise, please make sure the door is closed properly.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
